_about: Config for .claude/skills/reel/tools/capture_app_screens.js: the real screens of the free course demo that reel-8 shows inside its phone. Run: node capture_app_screens.js Content/reel-8-course/tools/capture.config.json <temp-folder>, then python Content/reel-7-course/src/to_webp.py <temp-folder> Content/reel-8-course/assets/screens. Re-run it whenever the course app changes (it got cover pictures on 2026-09-20, after reel-7's screens were taken).
